     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?, churn?} (churn: {files, insertions,
    21	#      deletions}, non-negative integers; Sprint 259), post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    22	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    23	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    24	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    25	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    26	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    27	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    28	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    29	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    30	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    31	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    32	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    33	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    34	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    35	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    36	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    37	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    38	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    39	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    40	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    41	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    42	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    43	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    44	#
    45	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    46	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    47	# =============================================================================
    48	set -euo pipefail
    49	export LC_ALL=C
    50	
    51	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    52	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    53	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    54	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    55	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    56	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    57	
    58	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    59	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    60	
    61	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    62	  case "$1" in
    63	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    64	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    65	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    66	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    68	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    72	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    73	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    74	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    75	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    76	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    77	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    79	popd >/dev/null
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    82	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    83	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    84	
    85	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    86	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    87	for group in tasks smoke; do
    88	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    89	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    90	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    91	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    92	    d="${d%/}"
    93	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    94	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    95	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    96	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    97	    fi
    98	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    99	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   100	    else
   101	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   102	    fi
   103	  done
   104	done
   105	
   106	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   107	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   108	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   109	import json, os, re, sys
   110	
   111	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   112	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   113	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   114	out = []
   115	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   116	
   117	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   118	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   119	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   120	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}

Scope: pr/head.diff (16 files under evals/). Cite as head/<path>:<line>.

Concerns found in the first pass, for the dissenting voice to confirm or refute:

1. head/evals/tests/ablation-grade.bats:16 — BATS_BIN is a hard-coded personal path
   ($HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats); the symlink made at :48 dangles
   on any other machine, so AG-2 (bf-sh) and AG-7 (bats TAP) cannot pass outside the author's box.
2. head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:457 — refactor tasks leave the covering tests
   (the "suite stays green" oracle) editable by the agent: only conftest/helpers are grader_protected
   and hidden/manifest.json is empty, so weakened assertions grade green. SR-1 (:92) locks it in.
3. head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:570 vs the wrapper headers (seed-refactor-tasks.sh:115-116,
   seed-bugfix-tasks.sh:43-44): build-time skips (no covering test) and refusals (secret) consume a
   --select slot; fewer than N tasks are written while exit is 0.

   Python >= 3.11.4; on 3.11.2 every snapshot extraction raises and the grade exits 2. No guard.

   suite only (green at base by construction), never the structural check: CHANGES_REQUIRED on an
   untouched tree is scored wrong.
6. head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:196-198 — pytest counts read only the last line of
   stdout+stderr; a trailing stderr line (warning) zeroes the counts and fails the proof.

   and a freeze; neither is in the diff.

seed-corpus generated-path rule (seed-corpus-from-record.sh:202-213, :235-236, :709-713).

input.content:
# Sprint 1 Review Feedback

**Reviewer:** Senior Tech Lead Reviewer Agent
**Date:** 2026-10-21
**Sprint Reference:** grimoires/loa/sprint.md
**Implementation Report:** grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/reviewer.md
**Change under review:** `pr/head.diff` (16 files under `evals/`); citations are `head/<path>:<line>` with lines from `pr/head/`.

---

## Overall Assessment

The change adds the cycle-130 ablation grader (`ablation-grade.sh`, 1299 lines), two task seeders over a shared Python engine (`seed_tasks.py`), the generated-path exclusion for fix regions in `seed-corpus-from-record.sh` (with the pr-14/pr-15 manifests and SHA256SUMS regenerated), a `source.churn` schema extension in `validate-suite.sh`, and bats coverage for all of it. The grader's trust-boundary posture is good: no sourcing from variables, `tarfile.data_filter`, path checks on every manifest entry, meta/ never read, ids-only summaries. SHA256SUMS lines match the head manifests byte for byte, every script passes `bash -n` / `py_compile`, and the AG-13 self-greps hold.

The verdict is driven by seven high findings, three of them reproduced by execution here:

- The seeders' staging directory is never cleaned after a failed proof, so one failed candidate makes every later candidate fail with `[Errno 17] File exists` (reproduced for both seeders).
- Without a `patch(1)` binary the seeders fall back to `git apply`, which silently skips every file when the scratch tree sits inside another git work tree (exit 0, "Skipped patch"); the refactor proof then passes against an unpatched tree and a task is written for a behaviour-breaking commit (reproduced: the SR-3 "perf: skip the padding" commit became `refactor-01` with a PASS proof).
- `ablation-grade.bats` hard-codes one developer's `$HOME/.local/dotfiles/...` path as the bats binary.
- Three grader metric defects: refactor `verdict_accuracy` never consults the structural check (two dissent voices concur), the contamination scan flags `"$VAR"/dir` idioms as `outside_path`, and the review-catch reducer ignores the `anchor_line` field live dissent envelopes actually carry.

The implementation report (`reviewer.md`) is the PR description: it describes sixteen tasks under `grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks/` and a freeze that are not in the diff, and it carries no `## AC Verification` section. Treated as a process observation rather than a counted defect because the sprint definition here is the PR itself.

Seeder bats runs in this environment: SB-3, SB-4, SB-5, SR-2, SR-4 pass; SB-1, SB-2, SR-1, SR-3 fail here because the host has no `patch(1)` (which exposes high finding 3) and because `/tmp` is noexec and the bats temp dir lies inside a git repository (environment, noted under Observations). The grader bats suite needs fixtures outside this diff (smoke tasks, `freeze.sh`, `recall-vs-defects.sh`) and was reviewed by reading only.

**Verdict:** CHANGES REQUIRED

---

## Changes Required

### 1. Seeder: a failed proof poisons every later candidate (staging collision)

- **HIGH** (confidence: high) `head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:373` — after a candidate fails its proof the staging directory `stage/<tid>` is left behind while `taken.discard(tid)` frees the id; the next candidate gets the same id and `os.makedirs(fx)` raises `FileExistsError`, reported as a proof failure.
**File:** `head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:373` (bugfix), `head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:450` (refactor), `head/evals/harness/lib/seed_tasks.py:598-602` (failure path without cleanup)
**Issue:** `main()` only removes `stage` at the very end (`shutil.rmtree(stage)` at :617). A `proof-failed`, `skip` or `secret` return leaves `stage/bugfix-01/` on disk; `next_id` (:332-339) checks `taken` and `tasks_dir`, not `stage`, so it hands out `bugfix-01` again.
**Why This Matters:** Reproduced here with two candidates in each mode. Newest-first order means one bad fix commit at the top of the window yields `written 0` for the whole run:
```
proof-failed be02fb4d67b8: not red at base (exit 0, 0 failed, 3 passed)
proof-failed 9666b206e19f: [Errno 17] File exists: '.../seed-stage.4f02gpoo/bugfix-01/fixture'
seed-bugfix: 2 candidate(s), 0 refused, 0 skipped; selected 2, written 0, proof failed 2
```
The bats tests never select two candidates where the first fails (SB-4 and SR-3 use a single candidate), so this is uncovered.
**Required Fix:** On every non-success return in the loop (:588-602) `shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(stage, tid), ignore_errors=True)` before `taken.discard(tid)`; or stage each candidate in its own `mkdtemp`. Add a two-candidate test where the newest fails and the older one must still be written.

### 2. Seeder: `git apply` fallback silently applies nothing, so the proof is vacuous
